Lynbrook Vet is a state of the art small animal primary care practice. We provide the entire range of veterinary services for our small animal patients and these are not limited to just helping you when you are at the clinic! We have created this channel to share with you our practical home care tips for your pets and answer any questions you may have because by working together that is how we can best improve the health outlook for all our pets.

Visit our website here: https://www.lynbrookvet.com.au.
Visit our Facebook page here: https://www.facebook.com/LynbrookVetClinic
